theme.rationale: Light theme offers the best canvas for photo galleries (simulating a white-wall gallery or bright campus vibe). A dark mode toggle is available for focused photo viewing and admin data diving.

typography.guidelines: Do not use Inter. Use Cabinet Grotesk for all display texts and IBM Plex Sans for tables, UI elements, and dashboard data. Use JetBrains Mono for system stats, face match percentages, and thresholds.

colors.guidelines: Strict monochrome baseline. 95% of UI should be grayscale. Use Signal Red (accent_primary) strictly for primary CTA, ML bounding boxes, and destructive actions. Use Warning Yellow (accent_secondary) for processing status. Never use generic blue.

layouts.general: Mobile-first responsive. Generous spacing (p-8 to p-12) for outer containers. Strict, tense spacing (gap-2, gap-4) within functional data widgets.
layouts.student_gallery: Masonry or dense grid layout (Grid View pattern). Use 'col-span-1 row-span-2' for tall photos. Dense tiles with minimal spacing (gap-1 or gap-2) to emphasize the imagery over the UI.
layouts.dashboards: Bento Grid protocol (High Density Grid). Base md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Widgets must have exact alignments. Use sharp, border-collapse styles where appropriate to expose the skeleton of the admin system.
layouts.face_enrollment: Center-focused module with dashed 1px technical borders. Drag-and-drop zone using 'The Technical Look'.

surfaces_and_visuals.cards: Flat solid surfaces with sharp edges (0px to max 4px radius). 1px solid border (#E5E5E5). NO drop shadows on resting states.
surfaces_and_visuals.hover_states: Slight lift (-translate-y-1) and a hard, stark shadow (e.g., 4px 4px 0px #0A0A0A) for a neo-brutalist tech feel on primary interactions.
surfaces_and_visuals.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for the sticky navbar and the photo detail viewer overlay. Light mode: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-black/5.
surfaces_and_visuals.bounding_boxes: When hovering over a detected photo, overlay a 2px solid Signal Red border box around the detected face with a tiny mono-font label showing the match percentage.

components.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none or rounded-sm). Primary: Solid black (or red) with white text. Hover: Invert colors or hard shadow.
components.inputs_forms: Shadcn based. Sharp borders, focus:ring-1 focus:ring-black. No soft glows.
components.tables: Shadcn Table for Admin and Panitia panels. Dense padding. Technical borders on bottom only.
components.badges: Square edges, Mono font for stats (e.g., 'Threshold: 0.40', 'Matches: 120').

motion.interactions: Crisp and fast transitions (150ms). Use framer-motion for page transitions and staggering gallery images on load.
motion.image_viewer: Use framer-motion layout animations to smoothly expand a photo into the detail viewer.
motion.loading: Instead of generic spinners, use an ASCII or mono-font progress counter ('Scanning faces... 45%') for the ML pipeline vibe.

hero_background.description: Graduates in light blue robes at an outdoor ceremony. Use as the landing page hero background with a bg-black/40 overlay.

enrollment_placeholder_1.description: Portrait photograph of a woman. Use as a placeholder for the reference photo enrollment step.

enrollment_placeholder_2.description: Man in red crew neck shirt. Use as a secondary placeholder in face detection preview.

gallery_placeholder.description: A large crowd gathers at a university. Use for empty state or generic event cover photos.

libraries.icons: lucide-react (default for standard UI). Consider @phosphor-icons/react for thicker, technical dashboard weights if installing.
libraries.charts: Shadcn charts (recharts) for Admin system stats (faces detected over time).
libraries.animation: framer-motion (for layout shifts in galleries), react-dropzone (for bulk photo upload).

accessibility.contrast: Text over images MUST use text-shadow or a gradient overlay for APCA/WCAG AA compliance.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (Upload, Enroll Face, Tune Threshold) MUST have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Cabinet Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, and JetBrains Mono via Google Fonts or Fontshare.

Implement the layout with pure HTML/Tailwind for the landing page to achieve the 'Swiss Brutalist' look, using Shadcn specifically for complex logic forms, dialogs, and tables in the admin/panitia dashboards.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for any headings.
Ensure the Navbar contains an 'Export Source Code (.ZIP)' button globally.
The Photo detail viewer must clearly highlight the bounding boxes generated by YOLOv8 using absolute positioned div overlays with border-red-500. Add a hover effect to reveal match %.
Use react-dropzone for the Panitia bulk photo upload area. Style it with dashed borders and monospace typography to feel like an ML pipeline ingestion zone.
Data components (threshold tuning slider, processing queues) should feel technical and precise. Use monospace fonts for numbers.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) only where appropriate (like navbars over images).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx.
